title: Amazon Stock News (Oct 14, 2026): AMZN Falls 0.4% to $258.58
summary: Amazon (AMZN) closed at $258.58 on Oct 13, 2026, down 0.37% on light volume as the Nasdaq eased and Apple launched new smart home devices.
body_markdown:
At $258.58, Amazon sits 9.97% below its 52-week high of $287.20 and 31.93% above its 52-week low of $196.00. Its market value stands at $2.80 trillion.


## Why Amazon Stock Fell


No fetched source named a company-specific cause for Tuesday's 0.37% decline, and the move was small and in line with a softer Nasdaq. The day's coverage of Amazon centered on competition and valuation rather than on news from the company itself.


As reported by[Barron's](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/44e3206a-a255-3b83-94a0-ab1efc4b012f/apple-takes-on-amazon-with.html) on October 13, Apple released a new smart home lineup that the outlet framed as a challenge to Amazon in the category, and Apple finished the session with a market cap of $4.98 trillion.


Separately, an[Insider Monkey](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/investors-paying-more-walmart-amazon-200115149.html) column published the same day compared the earnings multiples of Walmart and Amazon, putting Amazon at about 31 times earnings against 37.48 times for Walmart. The comparison is the author's own analysis, not a statement from either company.


## AMZN Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to[Amazon's own news roundup](https://www.aboutamazon.com/md/news/company-news/amazon-news-today-top-stories-company) , Prime Video signed a six-year deal to become the exclusive global streaming home of the Emmy Awards, starting with the 2027 ceremony.
- The same company roundup lists a new Alexa tablet lineup starting at $229 and new kids tablets, extending Amazon's devices range.
- The day's 25.2 million shares traded ran 27.40% below average, so the decline came on light volume.


### Risks


- Apple's new smart home devices, as reported by Barron's, add competition in a category where Amazon has been a leading player.
- The stock closed only $0.16 above the session low and remains 9.97% below its 52-week high of $287.20.
- A 10-year Treasury yield of 5.22% keeps borrowing costs high for large growth stocks.
